Package model.creature

Class Creature

java.lang.Object
model.creature.Creature
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Arrow, Bat, Lailaps, Siren, Skeleton
public abstract class Creature extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a creature that spawns during gameplay.

Contains the shared characteristics and behaviors between different creatures. Creatures have these characteristics determined by their CreatureType, hp and maxhp, Position, and various flags.

    • Creature

      public Creature(CreatureType type)
      Constructs a creature of the given type.

      Sets the display character, Color. Sets the sprite. Intended for use by a subclass via super(...).

      Parameters:
      type - decides the initial characteristics of the creature

  • Method Details

    • tick

      public abstract boolean tick(Floor floor)
      Triggers the creature to do something on its turn.

      Each subclass of creature must define its own behavior on a turn.

      Parameters:
      floor - the Floor the creature is on, allows the creature to access it.
      Returns:
      true if the creature died as a result of its turn.

    • dropLoot

      public abstract void dropLoot(Floor floor)
      Triggers the creature to drop its Loot on death.

      Each subclass of creature must define what Loot it drops on death.

      Parameters:
      floor - the Floor the creature is on, allows the creature to create Loot there.
